title: The Injured Knee — A Step-by-Step Ligament and Meniscus Examination

hook.en: A twisted knee can be a sprain, a meniscus tear or an ACL rupture. Learn the order of the examination and the tests that tell them apart, including when not to test.
hook.ur: Mura hua knee sprain, meniscus tear ya ACL rupture ho sakta hai. Examination ki tartib aur woh tests seekhein jo inhein alag karte hain, saath ye bhi ke kab test nahi karna.

goal.en: By the end, you'll examine an injured knee in order, perform the Lachman, posterior sag, collateral stress and meniscus tests, and decide on imaging or referral.
goal.ur: End tak aap zakhmi knee ko tartib se examine karenge, Lachman, posterior sag, collateral stress aur meniscus tests karenge, aur imaging ya referral ka faisla karenge.

text.en: Start with **what happened**. A twist with a pop and **swelling within hours** suggests bleeding into the joint (**haemarthrosis**) from an **ACL tear**, a fracture or a patellar dislocation. Slow swelling over a day suggests a **meniscus** or other irritation. The examination then moves in order: **observe, check for effusion, palpate, test the range, test the ligaments, test the meniscus**.
text.ur: Pehle **kya hua** dekhein. Pop ke saath twist aur **ghanton mein sujan** joint ke andar khoon (**haemarthrosis**) ka ishara hai, jo **ACL tear**, fracture ya patellar dislocation se ho sakta hai. Ek din mein dheere dheere aane wali sujan **meniscus** ya doosri irritation ki taraf ishara karti hai. Phir examination tartib se chalti hai: **dekhna, effusion check, palpate, range, ligament tests, meniscus tests**.

text.en: Think of the knee as a hinge with two rubber bumpers and four straps. The bumpers (menisci) absorb load and can tear; the straps (the cruciate and collateral ligaments) keep the hinge from sliding or opening sideways. Each test checks one strap or one bumper, so you must know which one you are asking about.
text.ur: Knee ko ek hinge samjhein jis mein do rabar bumper aur chaar patte hain. Bumpers (menisci) bojh sambhalte aur phat sakte hain; patte (cruciate aur collateral ligaments) hinge ko phisalne ya bagal mein khulne se rokte hain. Har test ek patta ya ek bumper check karta hai, is liye aap ko pata hona chahiye ke kaun sa sawal poochh rahe hain.

steps.title: Look and find the swelling
steps.detail: Compare both knees: swelling, bruising, deformity and the patient's walking. Use the sweep or patellar tap to confirm an effusion. || Dekhein aur sujan dhoondein

steps.title: Test range and extension
steps.detail: A knee that cannot straighten (a locked knee) may have a bucket-handle meniscus tear and needs early referral. Also check the patella and the quadriceps. || Range aur extension test karein

steps.title: Test the ligaments
steps.detail: Lachman at 20° to 30° for the ACL; posterior sag and drawer for the PCL; valgus and varus stress at 0° and 30° for the collaterals. Test the good knee first. || Ligaments test karein

steps.title: Test the meniscus and decide
steps.detail: Joint line tenderness, McMurray and the Thessaly test, together with the history of twist, locking or catching. Decide on imaging, bracing and referral. || Meniscus test karein aur faisla karein

question.en: Which test is the best single clinical test for an ACL rupture?
question.ur: ACL rupture ke liye sab se behtar akela clinical test kaun sa hai?

feedback.en: That detects fluid, not the ACL.
feedback.ur: Yeh paani dhoondta hai, ACL nahi.

feedback.ur: Haan — yeh anterior drawer se zyada durust hai, khaas kar jab knee sooji ho.

rows.en: Knee at 20° to 30°; pivot shift leg straight to bent
rows.ur: Knee 20° se 30° par; pivot shift seedhi taang se mudti hui

rows.en: Knee bent with rotation, or standing at 20°
rows.ur: Rotation ke saath bent knee, ya 20° par khare hokar

text.en: **Look, sweep, move, ligaments, meniscus.** Do them in that order so the swollen, painful knee is not hurt by the hard tests first.
text.ur: **Dekhein, sweep, harkat, ligaments, meniscus.** Is tartib se karein taake sooji hui dardnak knee ko pehle sakht tests se nuksan na ho.

text.en: **Pushing hard on a guarded, swollen knee.** A painful knee tenses and hides laxity, so a normal Lachman test early on does not exclude an ACL tear. Test gently, compare with the other side, and repeat when the swelling settles or arrange imaging.
text.ur: **Guarded, sooji hui knee par zor lagana.** Dardnak knee tight ho kar laxity chhupa leta hai, is liye shuru mein normal Lachman ACL tear ko exclude nahi karta. Aahista test karein, doosri side se muqabla karein, aur sujan thamne par dobara test karein ya imaging karwayein.

question.en: Valgus laxity at 0° and at 30° with no firm end-point after a ski fall suggests what?
question.ur: Ski se girne ke baad 0° aur 30° par valgus laxity bina firm end-point ke kya batati hai?

text.en: A severe MCL injury, likely with cruciate or capsule involvement; refer
text.ur: Shadeed MCL injury, jis mein cruciate ya capsule shamil ho sakte hain; refer

feedback.en: Yes — laxity when straight means more than the MCL is injured.
feedback.ur: Haan — seedhi knee par laxity ka matlab MCL se zyada structure zakhmi hain.

feedback.en: Opening on valgus stress is abnormal when firm end-points are absent.
feedback.ur: Firm end-point na ho to valgus stress par kulna ghair-normal hai.

question.en: A knee will not straighten fully after a twist and feels as if something is blocking it. What do you suspect?
question.ur: Twist ke baad knee poori seedha nahi hota aur lagta hai kuch rok raha hai. Aap ko kya shak hai?

feedback.en: A strain does not block extension mechanically.
feedback.ur: Strain extension ko mechanically nahi rokta.

text.en: A normal finding in a swollen knee
text.ur: Sooji hui knee mein normal finding

feedback.en: A block to extension is abnormal.

text.en: A locked knee from a displaced meniscus tear, which needs early referral
text.ur: Displaced meniscus tear se locked knee, jise jaldi referral chahiye

feedback.en: Yes — a mechanical block to extension is a reason for early specialist review.
feedback.ur: Haan — extension mein mechanical rukawat jaldi specialist review ki wajah hai.

text.en: **Know when to image.** Use the Ottawa knee rule for fractures: age 55 or more, tenderness of the head of the fibula, isolated tenderness of the patella, inability to bend to 90°, or inability to take four steps. A suspected ACL, PCL or multi-ligament injury, a locked knee or a hot swollen joint also needs specialist review.
text.ur: **Imaging kab karwani hai, jaanein.** Fractures ke liye Ottawa knee rule istemal karein: umar 55 ya zyada, fibula ke head par tenderness, patella par isolated tenderness, 90° tak na mur pana, ya chaar qadam na le pana. Shak wali ACL, PCL ya multi-ligament injury, locked knee ya garam sooji joint ko bhi specialist review chahiye.

question.en: Why does a rapid swelling within two hours of a twisting injury worry you more than a slow one?
question.ur: Twist injury ke do ghante ke andar tezi se sujan sust sujan se zyada pareshan kyun karti hai?

answer.en: Rapid swelling usually means bleeding into the joint (haemarthrosis), which suggests a serious injury such as an ACL tear, a fracture or a patellar dislocation. Slow swelling is more often irritation or fluid from a meniscus or strain. Early swelling is a reason for a careful examination and often for imaging.
answer.ur: Tezi se sujan aam taur par joint ke andar khoon (haemarthrosis) ka matlab hai, jo ACL tear, fracture ya patellar dislocation jaisi serious chot ka ishara hai. Sust sujan aksar meniscus ya strain se irritation ya paani hoti hai. Jaldi sujan ehtiyat ki examination aur aksar imaging ki wajah hai.

beats.patient: A 23-year-old footballer felt a pop when he planted his foot and turned. The knee swelled in two hours and now he walks with a limp. The Lachman test is positive with a soft end-point.
beats.assessment: The history and a positive Lachman make an ACL tear likely; swelling points to bleeding in the joint.
beats.treatment: Protect the knee, check for a locked knee, apply the Ottawa rule, arrange imaging and refer to a specialist, and begin early range and quadriceps exercises.
beats.reassess: The MRI confirms an ACL tear with a small meniscus injury; a specialist plan is made and rehabilitation starts.

text.en: **Refer urgently** for a hot, red, swollen knee with fever (septic arthritis), a locked knee, a knee that gives way with new swelling after trauma, a cold or pale foot after a knee dislocation, or inability to take weight after trauma (fracture risk).
text.ur: **Fori refer karein** bukhar ke saath garam, laal, sooji hui knee (septic arthritis), locked knee, trauma ke baad nayi sujan ke saath giving way, knee dislocation ke baad thanda ya peela pair, ya trauma ke baad wazan na utha pana (fracture ka khatra).

summary.en: Examine an injured knee in order (look, effusion, range, ligaments, meniscus); early swelling suggests bleeding into the joint and a serious injury.
summary.ur: Zakhmi knee ko tartib se examine karein (dekhna, effusion, range, ligaments, meniscus); jaldi sujan joint mein khoon aur serious chot ki taraf ishara hai.

summary.en: The Lachman is the best ACL test; test the collaterals at 0° and 30°; the meniscus tests and joint line tenderness are best combined with the history.
summary.ur: Lachman behtareen ACL test hai; collaterals ko 0° aur 30° par test karein; meniscus tests aur joint line tenderness history ke saath milakar behtar hain.

summary.en: A guarded knee hides laxity, a locked knee or multi-ligament injury needs early referral, and the Ottawa knee rule decides on an X-ray.
summary.ur: Guarded knee laxity chhupati hai, locked knee ya multi-ligament injury ko jaldi referral chahiye, aur Ottawa knee rule X-ray ka faisla karta hai.
